title: Network exceptions
prompt: Demonstrate package-manager and MCP network allowances without granting unnecessary access to other destinations.

examples.code:
name: scoped-access
config:
  type: cloud
  networking:
    type: limited
    allowed_hosts: []
    allow_package_managers: true
    allow_mcp_servers: true
Cards: package-manager allowance = maintained registry and code-host list; MCP allowance = configured agent MCP endpoints; neither adds web_search/web_fetch result hosts.

takeaway: Demonstrate package-manager and MCP network allowances without granting unnecessary access to other destinations.
